notes: Vanilla Fury at 60: Bloodthirst on cooldown, Whirlwind while it is down, Execute below 20 percent, Heroic Strike as the rage dump. Rage, not the global cooldown, is the limiting resource, so Bloodrage is used on cooldown; Death Wish and Recklessness are held for the execute phase unless that costs a use. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/ (the one its manifest.json records last); a later Forever patch may renumber them and tests/test_apl.py will say so. Nothing here is Forever-specific yet: the validation job (design section 6) is the evidence for changing it. 2026-11-02 (launch guide rewrite, round-11 engine, 10000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, raid / bare): Bloodrage then Battle Shout before the pull, no Charge (the pre-pull Bloodrage puts the warrior in combat, so Charge cannot be cast; a Charge in Battle Stance with the swap back measured a wash then: -0.2% raid, +0.3% bare), Whirlwind on cooldown behind Bloodthirst instead of only while Bloodthirst is down, Heroic Strike from 60 rage and none from 25% once Execute is trained (pooling with no Execute to spend it on lost 7% at 20). 750.0 to 755.1 raid (+0.7%), 272.0 to 277.0 bare (+1.8%); bare by level 34.5 to 34.3 at 20, 59.9 to 59.5 at 30, 125.0 to 126.2 at 40, 190.3 to 193.2 at 50. Hamstring under a Windfury Totem lost at every rage threshold tried (0, 40, 60), so Fury has no Hamstring line. 2026-11-03 (round 12): the pre-pull Battle Shout is skipped when a raid warrior's shout is already up; solo and bare levels still shout. Client 1.60.1.70755: Raging Blows is gone (its node is Improved Whirlwind, 2 sec off Whirlwind's cooldown and 30% more damage to the closest target), and Reckless Swings (1329555, a talent ability: 15 sec cooldown, the next four landed white swings within 8 sec each generate 5 more rage, 25% of base health) is cast on cooldown right behind Whirlwind.

level_notes.notes: First, in the Execute phase, ahead of Bloodthirst: it takes every point of rage you hold.
On cooldown, right behind Bloodthirst: it hits up to four targets with both weapons.
On cooldown, right behind Whirlwind: your next four white swings that land within 8 seconds each bring 5 more rage, and it costs a quarter of your base health, which the healers cover.
On cooldown under 80 rage, except hold it for the fears on Magmadar, Onyxia and Nefarian: rage from the hits you take, and 5 rage at once with Improved Berserker Rage 1/2 or 10 with 2/2.
Never at 60: Overpower needs Battle Stance, and Fury fights in Berserker Stance.
Only above 60 rage, and never once the boss is under a quarter of its health: hold that rage for Execute. It is queued on your next swing and costs no global cooldown.

priorityList.notes: Whenever rage is under 80: 10 rage at once and 10 more over 10 seconds, back every minute. With Improved Bloodrage both are a quarter more at 1/2 and half more at 2/2, to 15 and 15.
At the pull when a second one still fits, otherwise in the Execute phase, or in the last 30 seconds when that phase is shorter than the buff.
In the Execute phase, or in the last 15 seconds when that phase is short. It is a once-a-fight button.
Whenever it drops: 10 rage for the melee attack power of every party and raid member within 20 yards.
First, in the Execute phase: it takes every point of rage you hold, and from 40 it goes ahead of Bloodthirst too.
On cooldown: the button you lose the most by delaying.
On cooldown: it hits up to four targets with both weapons, and from 40 it sits right behind Bloodthirst.

On cooldown, right behind Whirlwind once you have it: your next four white swings that land within 8 seconds each bring 5 more rage, and it costs a quarter of your base health, which the healers cover.

With a Windfury Totem on you, right after Reckless Swings, while the target is above 25%: 10 rage for a main-hand hit that can trigger the totem's strike. Without the totem it is rage Bloodthirst and Whirlwind need.
From 36, on cooldown under 80 rage, except hold it for the fears on Magmadar, Onyxia and Nefarian: rage from the hits you take, and 5 rage at once with Improved Berserker Rage 1/2 or 10 with 2/2.
Only before level 36, while you still fight in Battle Stance. Once Whirlwind is trained you live in Berserker Stance and it never comes up.
Only above 60 rage, and, once you have Execute, never from 25% down: hold that rage for it. It is queued on your next swing and costs no global cooldown.

expected_idle.reason: Hamstring is gated on the Windfury Totem buff (spell 10610), which the engine registers only for a character a totem reaches; the ladder character has no raid around it, so the gate is false and the line correctly never fires at any level. In the raid-ready run it is a free-global filler between Reckless Swings and Berserker Rage.
